snippet.title: Maneki Mania - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside. Watch the Maneki Mania trailer for this upcoming incremental arcade game. Maneki Mania will be available on PC on December 11, 2026.
